details:
MISSION FORGE is an educational space mission design game developed by Team TERA VISION. It aims to make spacecraft engineering and space exploration more accessible through an interactive learning experience.

Players can explore different space missions, understand their objectives, design spacecraft, select components, and evaluate whether their configurations meet mission requirements. The game introduces simplified engineering concepts, including payload compatibility, spacecraft systems, and solar power availability based on planetary distance.

One of the project's distinctive features is its educational approach to engineering decisions. For example, players must select suitable payloads and subsystems for specific missions and understand why certain components are required. The simulation also uses simplified scientific models based on publicly available planetary reference data. These models are educational approximations rather than high-fidelity spacecraft or orbital simulations.

MISSION FORGE was designed to encourage scientific curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and interest in aerospace engineering, especially among students and beginners. By turning complex concepts into interactive challenges, the project seeks to make space science more engaging and understandable.

The application was developed using React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Router, Zustand, and Vite. NASA educational resources and planetary reference data informed selected aspects of the project's educational content and simplified scientific models.

Our creativity lies in combining mission planning, spacecraft configuration, engineering constraints, scientific explanations, and interactive simulation in one educational experience.

Our team considered scientific plausibility, usability, educational value, accessibility, and the importance of clearly distinguishing simplified game models from real-world aerospace engineering.
